title: Helpdesk Intake Opened
description: Creator-collab slice 6: a visitor opened an intake session in pmoves.room.helpdesk. Carries the intake_id, room_id, agent_id (the visitor's persona), intent hint (optional), and the room directory snapshot version that was used for routing. Emitted by pmoves-helpdesk-skill at session-open. Consumed by nats_event_bus + dashboard to render intake traffic.

intake_id.description: Stable identifier for the intake session

room_id.description: Room that opened the intake (typically pmoves.room.helpdesk)

agent_id.description: Agent identity of the visitor (persona, fleet agent, or anonymous)

persona_role.description: Optional role hint from the visitor's persona (e.g. 'resident', 'creator', 'operator')

intent_hint.description: Optional short hint from the visitor (first sentence of the question)

directory_version.description: Version of the room directory snapshot the helpdesk read to route this intake

meta.description: Free-form metadata (parent session id, source surface, etc.)
